notes.title: Intrusion Protocol Linux Release
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce the Linux release of Intrusion Protocol. 

So to all our friends on Linux, do you have what it takes to survive Intrusion Protocol?

notes.title: Intrusion Protocol 1.05 / Halloween Update Released
notes.notes:
- Fixed Dy-sync Bug with Crushers

- Fixed Bug where death sound became super loud if you adjusted volume settings

- The Level Timer will no longer start until after the player presses an input (This does not affect the leaderboard timer, only the detection timer)

- Added a camera shutter sound to screenshot activation

- Added motion effects to all the hidden tail pickups to make them more visually apparent and interesting

- Added 4 Halloween themed tails
        - Blood
        - Bats
        - Jack O Lantern Grin
        - Banshee Skull

notes.title: Temporary Rollback to 1.01
notes.notes: After discovering a bug where dying between checkpoints was incorrectly resetting the level, we have temporarily rolled back to version 1.01. We aplogoize for this bug. A new patch will be available shortly.

notes.title: Intrusion Protocol 1.02 Released
notes.notes:
- Fixed Hazard hit-box on stage 8 that could kill player through a wall.

- Decreased base volume of player death effect

- Decreased base volume of Intrusion Detected effect

- The clock will now restart if the player dies before reaching the first checkpoint

- The Achievement for beating the game on Hard should no longer unlock on easy.

notes.title: Intrusion Protocol 1.01 Released
notes.notes:
We have released a quick hot fix for a couple issues.

- Invisible hazard on stage 7 has been made visible

- Corrected a tiling error on Stage 10

- The Achievement for beating the developers time on Stage 10 will now unlock if earned.
